findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_strategy, star_strategy, search_mcp_servers, get_mcp_server · Private data: backtest_export, run_strategy, publish_strategy, list_strategies, get_strategy, star_strategy, comment_strategy, register_strategy, get_verified_record, verified_board, verify_chain, retire_strategy, claim_mcp_server · Public sink: publish_strategy, list_strategies, get_strategy, star_strategy, get_verified_record, verified_board, retire_strategy · Destructive: backtest_export, run_backtest, run_strategy, compare_runs, publish_strategy, list_strategies, star_strategy, survivorship_audit, translate_stockcharts_scan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_strategy, star_strategy, search_mcp_servers, get_mcp_server · Private data: backtest_export, run_strategy, publish_strategy, list_strategies, get_strategy, star_strategy, comment_strategy, register_strategy, get_verified_record, verified_board, verify_chain, retire_strategy, claim_mcp_server · Public sink: publish_strategy, list_strategies, get_strategy, star_strategy, get_verified_record, verified_board, retire_strategy · Destructive: backtest_export, run_backtest, run_strategy, compare_runs, publish_strategy, list_strategies, star_strategy, survivorship_audit, translate_stockcharts_scan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
